browserAuthenticationControlPlane.login: GET /auth/login accepts only same-origin relative returnUrl and starts Authorization Code + PKCE with one-time state/nonce
browserAuthenticationControlPlane.session: GET /auth/session is no-store and returns only principalId, displayName, expiresAt and csrfToken; never Bearer tokens
browserAuthenticationControlPlane.logout: POST /auth/logout requires CSRF, clears the local session and uses controlled same-origin redirect or 204
browserAuthenticationControlPlane.cookie: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax; callback correlation cookies are framework managed
browserAuthenticationControlPlane.verificationOwner: T05/T33 real end-to-end authentication tests; not executed by T01
